svg.title: Drizzlet hidden options guide
svg.desc: Four pages of mix knob settings with quality LED [A] colour and blink indications. Full text version in OPTIONS.md.

Turn a mix knob (not a big knob) to change
another button. On page 1 with Pitch scale
on Scale, tap SEED to step the scale.
Release the exit button before normal use.
It saves by itself; wait before powering

Hold the quality button [A], then press
SEED [C] to toggle. Best with the first two
Hold [A], then press FREEZE [B] to start a
fresh recording window. The next freeze
keeps only what was recorded since.
With the Plaits synth playing, FEEDBACK
selects one of eight models and [A]+FREEZE
[B] steps the bank instead of trimming:
green, red, yellow, then green again. [A]
flashes the bank colour; FREEZE stays as it
Hold [A] and turn DRY/WET; fully CCW is
Stock. The [A] LED shows the width as a
meter; releasing [A] saves it. Once on, [M]
can route CV to it (all three mix LEDs
Hold [A] and turn FEEDBACK to set the input
gain by hand; the [A] LED shows it as a
meter. With an input patched, a long press
Hold [A] and turn REVERB; fully CCW is
none. Once set, [M] can route CV to it
With Synth start on Manual, both inputs
unplugged and FREEZE off, hold [A] for
about a second and a half to start or stop
